cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import io, re
FILES = ["outputs/three_body.html", "outputs/simulate_three_body.py"]
OLD_SENT = "本初值是著名的 Chenciner–Montgomery “8 字”周期轨道的近似初值，周期约 6.916，因此 12.65 个时间单位约相当于 1.83 个周期。"
NEW_SENT = ("本初值是著名的 Chenciner–Montgomery “8 字”周期轨道的近似初值；"
            "由本次积分的采样数据看，系统状态在 t ≈ 6.33 回到起点附近（周期约 6.326），"
            "因此 t = 12.65 约相当于两个周期。")
# 需要注入声明的选择器 -> 追加的声明
DECLS = {
    "main": "max-width:100%",
    ".card": "min-width:0;max-width:100%",
    "table": "max-width:100%;table-layout:fixed",
    "th,td": "overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:break-word",
    "th:first-child,td:first-child": "width:26%",
    ".kv": "grid-template-columns:minmax(0,auto) minmax(0,1fr);min-width:0",
    ".kv div:nth-child(2n)": "min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere",
    ".hud": "min-width:0",
    ".hud b": "overflow-wrap:anywhere",
    ".legend": "min-width:0",
    ".chip": "max-width:100%;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere",
    ".controls": "min-width:0",
    ".slider-row": "flex-wrap:wrap;min-width:0",
    "input[type=range]": "min-width:0;flex:1 1 0",
    "output": "min-width:0;flex:0 0 auto",
    "button": "max-width:100%",
    "select": "max-width:100%",
    "label": "min-width:0;max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere",
    ".slider-label": "overflow-wrap:anywhere",
    ".tag": "max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere",
    "code": "overflow-wrap:anywhere",
    ".warn": "overflow-wrap:anywhere;max-width:100%",
    "ul": "min-width:0",
    "ul li": "min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere",
    "footer": "max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere",
    "h1": "overflow-wrap:anywhere",
    ".sub": "overflow-wrap:anywhere",
    "canvas": "max-width:100%",
}
OLD_MEDIA = "@media (min-width:980px){main{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.2fr) minmax(360px,.95fr)}}"
NEW_MEDIA = "@media (min-width:980px){main{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.2fr) minmax(0,.95fr)}}"

def add_decl(text, sel, decls):
    i = text.index(sel + "{")
    j = text.index("}", i)
    glue = "" if text[j-1] in ";{ \n\t" else ";"
    return text[:j] + glue + decls + text[j:], 1

def replace_media_small(text):
    anchor = "@media (max-width:620px){"
    i = text.index(anchor)
    depth, k = 0, i
    while True:
        c = text[k]
        if c == "{": depth += 1
        elif c == "}":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0: break
        k += 1
    new = (anchor + "canvas{max-height:54vh}button{flex:1 1 auto}"
           "main{padding-left:8px;padding-right:8px}"
           "header,footer{padding-left:9px;padding-right:9px}"
           ".card{padding:10px}"
           "th,td{font-size:10.5px;padding:3px 2px}"
           ".hud{font-size:12px}.kv{font-size:12px}.sub,.tag,.chip{font-size:11.5px}"
           ".legend,.hud,.controls{gap:6px 8px}"
           "output{min-width:0;flex:1 0 auto;text-align:left}}")
    return text[:i] + new + text[k+1:], 1

for path in FILES:
    src = io.open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
    orig = src
    n_sent = src.count(OLD_SENT)
    assert n_sent == 1, (path, "sentence count", n_sent)
    src = src.replace(OLD_SENT, NEW_SENT)
    assert "6.916" not in src and "1.83 个周期" not in src
    assert src.count(OLD_MEDIA) == 1
    src = src.replace(OLD_MEDIA, NEW_MEDIA)
    for sel, decls in DECLS.items():
        if sel + "{" in src:
            src, _ = add_decl(src, sel, decls)
        else:
            raise AssertionError(f"selector not found: {sel}")
    src, _ = replace_media_small(src)
    # 注入全局收缩规则
    a = ".card{"
    src = src.replace(a, "main>*{min-width:0;max-width:100%}\n" + a, 1)
    assert "overflow-x" not in src and "overflow:" not in src, "不得用隐藏溢出掩盖裁切"
    io.open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(src)
    print(f"edited {path}: {len(orig)} -> {len(src)} bytes")
print("OK: 周期说明与窄屏 CSS 已局部修正（HTML 与生成器模板同步）")
PY
